description: Ministry of Internal & Home Affairs - The Regulations of Sumangala Piriven Rajamaha Viharasthana  Duruthu Maha Perahera, Wariyapola
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by a minister under the Pilgrimages Ordinance, establishing legal rules and compliance requirements for a specific religious festival. It creates a regulatory framework for managing pilgrimages, including traffic control, sanitation, health measures, and enforcement provisions. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
